exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Modals of advice — should, ought to

items.prompt: You ___ save the email as a draft and send it at 9 a.m.
A good manager ___ never email the team at midnight.
items.hintAfterError: Um dos modais de conselho nunca vem seguido de 'to'; o outro sempre precisa dele.

items.prompt: Leaders ought ___ model a healthy work-life balance.
If it's truly urgent, you ___ pick up the phone.
You ___ send non-urgent emails after 10 p.m.
items.hintAfterError: Forma negativa do modal de conselho.
